name: Robledillo de la Vera (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Robledillo de la Vera (a sword above an oak on white).
history: Municipal flag of Robledillo de la Vera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Robledillo de la Vera arms — sword above an oak
